title: How-To Geek (2010): Make a book from Wikipedia articles

steps.quote: To do this, click **Create a book** under **Print/export** on the left sidebar in Wikipedia.
steps.text: To do this, click Create a book under Print/export on the left sidebar in Wikipedia.
